description: Na₃VO₄ is Enargite structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmn2₁ space group. There are two inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to four O²⁻ atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent VO₄ tetrahedra and corners with eight equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.33 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to four O²⁻ atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent VO₄ tetrahedra and corners with eight NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.29 Å. V⁵⁺ is bonded to four O²⁻ atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with twelve NaO₄ tetrahedra. There is one shorter (1.72 Å) and three longer (1.73 Å) V-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent O²⁻ sites. In the first O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to three Na¹⁺ and one V⁵⁺ atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₃V trigonal pyramids. In the second O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to three Na¹⁺ and one V⁵⁺ atom to form corner-sharing ONa₃V tetrahedra. In the third O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to three Na¹⁺ and one V⁵⁺ atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₃V tetrahedra.
